svg.title: Launch Manager - Queued Run Target activation

g.text: Launch Manager - Queued Run Target activation
Components StateManager and setup_filesystems.sh are Ready.
Receiving multiple queued Run Target activation requests
[Run Target "Running" is invalid (Example: Run Target not configured)]
[Run Target "Full" is invalid (Example: Run Target not configured)]
The following sequence assumes that both requests have been accepted.
Process next queued Run Target Activation: Run Target "Running"
Invoke callback: Run Target "Running" successfully activated due to Request
Process next queued Run Target Activation: Run Target "Full"
Invoke callback: Run Target "Full" successfully activated due to Request
